build_modelopt_fp8_quant_config: build a ModelOpt FP8 quantization config from a HuggingFace quantization config dictionary
create_modelopt_fp8_linear_method: create a ModelOpt FP8 linear method that loads FP8 checkpoints with static weight and activation scales
create_modelopt_nvfp4_linear_method: create a ModelOpt NVFP4 linear method that loads NVFP4 checkpoints with per-block scales
run_modelopt_mxfp8_moe_apply: run ModelOpt MXFP8 fused MoE apply with FlashInfer TRTLLM backend for swiglu activation
build_modelopt_mixed_precision_config: build a ModelOpt mixed precision config that maps per-layer quantization algorithms like FP8 and NVFP4
